name: Yatsu Murasaki

Artist: [url=/s533]Kagami Hirotaka[/url]

History:
Demon Yatsu Murasaki is the hypothetical Inner Demon of [url=/c6812]Yatsu Murasaki[/url].
[spoiler]The inner denom was awakened by an experiment done by Edwin Black, that was trying to turn Murasaki into a gateway to Otherworld by inserting into her body a Philosopher's Stone. After the experiment is confirmed that a Philosopher's Stone can force a Taimanin into transformation.[/spoiler]
[Edited from [url=https://breezewiki.com/taimanin/wiki/Demon_Murasaki]breezewiki.com[/url]]
